## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Prague, Czechia. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at Žižkov Television Tower, Mahlerovy sady 1, 130 00 Praha 3-Žižkov, Czechia. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Žižkov Television Tower Observatory. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Indulge in an architecturally-focused exploration of Prague, designed for those fascinated by historical marvels and modern wonders. Your voyage through Prague's urban panorama begins with an included ticket to the Žižkov Television Tower Observatory, offering vistas that span the entire city.
>
> Please note that while the exteriors of these landmarks are focal points, an audio tour within the Žižkov Television Tower Observatory itself is not included.
>
> Starting from the towering Žižkov Television Tower, the route will guide you through the pulsating heart of bohemian pubs, sweep you past the architectural splendor at the National Museum, and serenade you with stories beside the State Opera. You'll then continue the journey encountering heritage and art, touching upon the legendary Statue of Saint Wenceslas and the mystique of Franz Kafka sculpture, before drifting along the scenic Vltava River Promenade.
>
> The finale is a view at Dancing House, where Prague’s historical narrative gives way to bold architectural innovation. Along the way, you'll experience the intriguing contrast of Prague’s gothic past and dynamic present, from quaint gardens to the glint of Kafka's enigmatic sculpture. Allow the rhythm of the Vltava River to guide you through a city where every corner tells a story and every view is a masterpiece.
